summary: The targetwise collision sum is counted correctly by pairing the two ordered orientations of each unordered off-diagonal edge, yielding x_t <= a_t/8. The accepted affine-slice theorem applies to A = aff(T_x), for which q <= 1, and its ambient bounds give G >= W_A/4 >= 2|x| in both the full-space and proper-slice cases. All consequences, including the strict Q/200 bound and the rank obstruction for the off-diagonal optimizer, follow with the stated constants.
